SELECT
  w.wordid AS word_id,
  w.word AS word,
  total_synsets,
  total_senses,
  distinct_domains,
  distinct_posids,
  (SELECT s.synsetid FROM senses s 
   WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid 
   GROUP BY s.synsetid 
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC 
   LIMIT 1) AS top_synsetid,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s 
   WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid 
   AND s.synsetid = (SELECT s2.synsetid FROM senses s2 
                     WHERE s2.wordid = w.wordid 
                     GROUP BY s2.synsetid 
                     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s2.synsetid ASC 
                     LIMIT 1)) AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    w.wordid,
    w.word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM words w
  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
  HAVING total_synsets >= 2
    AND distinct_domains >= 2 
    AND total_senses >= 2
) w
ORDER BY
  total_senses DESC,
  total_synsets DESC,
  distinct_domains DESC,
  word_id ASC
LIMIT 500;

input.command: sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT name,tbl_name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index';" 2>&1 | head -80
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM senses; SELECT count(*) FROM words; SELECT count(*) FROM synsets;"

cat > /app/sol.sql <<'EOF'
WITH sc AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM senses s
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
agg AS (
  SELECT sc.wordid AS wordid,
    COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
    SUM(sc.cnt) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM sc JOIN synsets syn ON sc.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY sc.wordid
  HAVING total_synsets >= 2 AND distinct_domains >= 2 AND total_senses >= 2
),
top AS (
  SELECT sc.wordid AS wordid, sc.synsetid AS top_synsetid, sc.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.wordid ORDER BY sc.cnt DESC, sc.synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM sc
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word,
  agg.total_synsets, agg.total_senses, agg.distinct_domains, agg.distinct_posids,
  top.top_synsetid, top.top_synset_sense_count
FROM agg
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = agg.wordid
JOIN top ON top.wordid = agg.wordid AND top.rn = 1
ORDER BY agg.total_senses DESC, agg.total_synsets DESC, agg.distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
cd /app
echo "=== original timing ==="
time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql > /tmp/orig.out
echo "=== new timing ==="
time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < sol.sql > /tmp/new.out
echo "=== diff ==="
diff /tmp/orig.out /tmp/new.out && echo IDENTICAL
wc -l /tmp/orig.out /tmp/new.out
